sourceObservations: The source is recognizable wooden shelving with boxes and a separate broad fallen board. It reads mainly as stacked flat slabs and small dark posts; its large unbroken top consumes much of the screen silhouette, especially E/W.

N exposes the diagonal back brace. S exposes the contents and detached board; E/W remain extremely narrow and roof dominated under the registered projection. The native model is truly3D, and unseen views require purposeful reconstruction rather than a copy of a front paint-over.
Atphone224x336, shelf apertures survive but stored boxes are mostly small tabs under front edges. The warm muted wood family is relevant, yet box/frame separation and worn construction cues are weak.

Source lighting is symmetric and broadly soft. Lower compartments are dark ochre/brown but not uniformly black. A better result should increase readable depth and material distinction without turning cavities into black strips.
